usage: aura new [app|evolve|evolve-moo|agent] <dir>

Scaffold a project in <dir> (must not exist or be empty).
  app         modules + tests (default)
  evolve      live AST: each KEEP / ROLLBACK printed in the terminal
  evolve-moo  multi-objective + QD search (mock proposer, no LLM)
  agent       orchestrated workflow
